decide.ts: tt.decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today")

choose.ts: tt.choose("Which team owns this?", "please route this ticket", { options: ["the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else"] })

tag.ts: tt.tag("Which words appear?", "the refund and the shipping", { labels: ["refund", "shipping"] })

score.ts: tt.score({ score: "How urgent is this?", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."] }, "maybe later")

filter.ts: tt.filter("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

rank.ts: tt.rank("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

find.ts: tt.find("Which line asks for money back?", ["good morning", "I want a refund"])

annotate.ts: tt.annotate("{\"version\":1,\"questions\":{\"wants_refund\":{\"decide\":\"Does the customer ask for a refund?\"},\"team\":{\"choose\":\"Which team owns this?\",\"options\":[\"billing\",\"shipping\",\"account\"]},\"urgency\":{\"score\":\"How urgent is this?\",\"levels\":[\"Routine.\",\"Soon.\",\"Immediate.\"]}}}", ["maybe later"])

recognize.ts: (await tt.recognize("Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.", { kinds: ["person", "organization", "place"] })).entities.map((one) => [one.text, one.kind])

relate.ts: (await tt.relate(["Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "Card charges are failing for every customer.", "The nightly export ran two hours late.", "The payments database ran out of disk space."], { relations: ["caused_by"] })).map((one) => [one.name, one.source, one.target, one.probability])
